# machine-health

MachineHealthChecks for automatic replacement of unhealthy nodes

```yaml
stack:
  machineHealth:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Which node roles are health-checked, and how aggressively

Under `stack.machineHealth.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `worker` |  |  |
| `worker.enabled` | Replace unhealthy worker nodes | `true` |
| `infra` |  |  |
| `infra.enabled` | Replace unhealthy infra nodes | `true` |
| `storage` |  |  |
| `storage.enabled` | Replace unhealthy storage nodes. Off by default; a rebuild triggers Ceph backfill. | `false` |
| `storage.timeout` | Longer than the default: storage nodes take longer to come back | `600s` |
| `storage.maxUnhealthy` |  | `1` |
| `storage.nodeStartupTimeout` |  | `15m` |
| `default` |  |  |
| `default.timeout` | How long a node may be NotReady before it is replaced | `300s` |
| `default.maxUnhealthy` | Stop replacing once this many are unhealthy, to avoid cascading drains | `40%` |
| `default.nodeStartupTimeout` |  | `10m` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CP-10 System Recovery and Reconstitution. Categories: CP Contingency Planning.

### Policy `config`

`config-machine-health-<cluster>`: MachineHealthChecks per MachineSet.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-checks` | enforce | [machine-health-checks](converters/machine-health-checks.yaml) | One MachineHealthCheck per discovered MachineSet |
